title: Interface: an API field
question: We (this repository, the backend) plan to remove the field greeting from the Query type in schema.graphql. What code in the other repositories would break? List repo/file:line, and say which repositories are unaffected.
answer_key:
web-app breaks: web-app/src/queries.graphql line 2 selects greeting in query Greet.
greet-lib and mail-app are unaffected.
Scoring: names web-app/src/queries.graphql (line 2, ±1) and calls greet-lib and mail-app unaffected = correct; web-app named without the file = partial; otherwise wrong.
lesson: Only the contract graph links a Python API to the clients that query it.
plain: The API team wants to delete the greeting field. Which client code would break?
